title: Bridging the Evidence-to-Execution Gap:A Reflective Agent for Multi-Objective Peptide Design
abstract: arXiv:2610.06190v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models can reason over scientific literature, but textual plans do not reliably produce biological sequences with the intended properties. Sequence generators capture sequence patterns, yet they do not interpret evidence, choose interventions, or reflect on outcomes. This separation creates an evidence-to-execution gap between scientific reasoning and sequence-level control. We introduce EASER, a reflective agent that connects the two through a learned property interface. The interface consists of property-specific low-rank directions trained offline and fixed during search; an LLM controller (the controller) composes them to steer a frozen diffusion generator. From retrieved evidence, sequence context, and prior outcomes, it proposes intervention hypotheses that specify anchors, editable positions, and coefficients. Probe-and-Steer tests these hypotheses and allocates further samples from their joint predicted respons

translated_title: 弥合证据到执行的鸿沟：面向多目标肽设计的反思型智能体
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型能够对科学文献进行推理，但文本形式的计划并不能可靠地生成具有预期性质的生物序列。序列生成器能够捕捉序列模式，却无法解读证据、选择干预措施或对结果进行反思。这种分离在科学推理与序列级控制之间造成了“证据到执行”的鸿沟。我们提出了EASER，一个通过学习到的性质接口将二者连接起来的反思型智能体。该接口由离线训练并在搜索过程中保持固定的性质特异性低秩方向组成；一个LLM控制器将这些方向组合起来，以引导冻结的扩散生成器。基于检索到的证据、序列上下文和先前的结果，控制器提出指定锚点、可编辑位置和系数的干预假设。Probe-and-Steer机制对这些假设进行测试，并根据它们联合预测的响应来分配后续采样……
tldr: 论文提出EASER反思型智能体，通过由性质特异性低秩方向构成的性质接口，让LLM控制器基于文献证据、序列上下文和先验结果组合干预假设以引导冻结的扩散生成器，从而弥合科学推理与序列级控制之间的“证据到执行”鸿沟，实现多目标肽设计。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces EASER, a reflective agent that bridges the evidence-to-execution gap in multi-objective peptide design by using an LLM controller to compose property-specific low-rank directions—guided by retrieved evidence, sequence context, and prior outcomes—to steer a frozen diffusion generator.
